label: D1 after an a1 -> S2 rare transition, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), almost only when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (87% of activation mass; prev_common==1 gets 0.5%, prev_action==2 gets 0.1%). It is also gated by time in the episode: there is zero activity before trial ~60, and the rate climbs through trials 70-99. It also fires only when model value is low (<7.1). Magnitude is highest when that rare trial was rewarded (rare-rewarded a1: dev P=0.55, R=0.46, F1=0.50, but mass recall 0.63), which is the case where a model-based agent should switch to a2. The top windows are mostly followed by an a2 choice. Within the pattern, precision is low (many a1-rare D1 steps stay silent, especially unrewarded ones), so it is partially explained. I recorded the broader, all-observed predicate because it covers 86% of the mass. Dev: P=0.29, R=0.82, F1=0.42.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, ?) and trial before (D1: a1 S1 r, a2 S1 r, ?); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
